question: Does the pinned interval kernel preserve nominal mean coverage in selected known same-population models, and does an informative proxy narrow intervals relative to the same real-only kernel?

source.license: MIT; Copyright (c) 2024 Intelligent Robot Motion Lab

runtime.dependencies: Use existing frozen Nisayon environment; no installation or synchronization.

models.name: informative_biased
models.description: Y~Bernoulli(0.4); paired Z=0.1+0.8Y. Additional Z from an independent identical population.

models.name: uninformative
models.description: Y~Bernoulli(0.4); paired and additional Z~Bernoulli(0.4), independent of Y.

models.name: anticorrelated
models.description: Y~Bernoulli(0.4); paired Z=1-Y. Additional Z from an independent identical population.

comparison: Same real draws in all three arms per replicate; no candidate search, optional stopping, adaptive model selection or parameter tuning after output.
rng: Independent SeedSequence by model index, sample count and replicate; separate recorded seed for upstream global-numpy shuffle.

coverage_check.null: miscoverage probability <= alpha for each of 18 method/model/count cells
coverage_check.test: Exact one-sided binomial tail on miscoverage count
coverage_check.interval: Clopper-Pearson simultaneous 95% coverage intervals, Bonferroni over 18 cells
coverage_check.interpretation: No detected undercoverage is not a validity proof; all cells and invalid outputs retained.

boundary_controls: constant zero Y=Z on all samples
constant one Y=Z on all samples
constant quarter Y=Z on all samples
affine normalization of accelerated kernel for a fixed bounded vector
numerics: Intersect returned intervals with known outcome support [0,1]; preserve empty intervals as misses, do not discard replicates. Reject non-finite/malformed outputs and fail the probe. Retain original source bodies; do not fix upstream numerics inside the comparator.
stop: Stop on invalid output, source mismatch, failed deterministic control or wall cap. Coverage failure requires diagnosis before any efficiency claim. No parameter retry to obtain a favorable result.
limits: Synthetic statistical trials only. Does not reproduce paper hardware figures, test distribution transport, qualify the whole upstream package, accept a robot deployment, demonstrate total savings or establish novelty.
